factions.theme: Peat-bog scavengers and drowned marsh predators; black wet hide, hollow ivory reeds, moss and muted green.

minions.name: Reedjaw Newt
minions.description: A low four-legged marsh newt with a shovel-shaped skull, pale hollow reed teeth projecting from its hinged jaw, slick black skin and a moss-fringed paddle tail; crouched, narrow and nimble.

minions.name: Peatbell Toad
minions.description: A squat eyeless toad with a translucent amber throat sac shaped like a cracked bell, warty peat-black hide, long webbed front fingers and a few ivory reed stubs on its back.

minions.name: Fen Lantern Snail
minions.description: A predatory snail with a broken spiral shell made of peat-stained bone, a dim green organ visible in the shell aperture, two forked tactile stalks and an elongated muscular black foot.

minions.name: Willow Knuckle
minions.description: A hunched root homunculus assembled from a willow stump; two oversized knotted root fists, two short root feet, a hollow vertical face slit with green sap and a sparse mantle of damp moss.

minions.name: Sedge Raker
minions.description: A gaunt marsh rail bird with four stilt legs, an ivory serrated bill, ragged black sedge feathers and a narrow hunched torso; one foot lifted as if stalking through shallow water.

minions.name: Bogglass Midge
minions.description: A single large predatory midge with four cracked transparent smoky wings, a long ivory piercing proboscis, six delicate hooked legs and a moss-green swollen abdomen; wings fully spread.

minions.name: Silt Mantle
minions.description: A flat slug-like scavenger whose leathery black mantle folds into an angular hood over a small lamprey mouth, six short sucker-ended feelers and pale grit embedded along the rim; no spiral shell.

minions.name: Mossback Mole
minions.description: A compact eyeless bog mole with enormous ivory digging palms, sparse dark whiskers, matted moss coat and damp black fur, a blunt rubbery snout and stubby tail.

minions.name: Rushbone Crake
minions.description: A thin flightless skeletal crane with reed-bundle legs, a crooked split beak and ragged peat-cloth plumage, three green seedlike eyes across its narrow skull and a fan of broken reed quills.

minions.name: Drowned Purse
minions.description: A fist-sized animate seed purse inflated into a leathery bladder, four tiny hooked legs, a stitched-looking natural mouth seam lined with ivory barbs, trailing root tassels and a dim green heart visible through wet hide.

factions.theme: midnight glacier chasm, vertical blue ice walls, hanging icicles, broad flat frozen lake and snowbanks

minions.name: Hoarfang Shrew
minions.description: Gaunt arctic shrew, oversized black incisors, matted white whiskers, ice blisters, narrow feet, naked curled tail

minions.name: Icicle Stilt
minions.description: Skeletal cave bird, two extremely long blue-black legs, dagger beak, ragged white feathers, vestigial wings edged with ice

minions.name: Glassback Mite
minions.description: Flattened eight-legged mite, single cloudy ice dome revealing dark organs, tiny scraping mouth, black toes, snow crust patches

minions.name: Snowblind Loper
minions.description: Eyeless predatory hare, swept-back frozen ears, huge hind legs, split fanged lip, smoke-gray fur, small forearms

minions.name: Sleet Sail
minions.description: Batlike ray with diamond translucent membrane wings, four bony spars, blunt toothed face, dangling claws, ribbon tail, slate veins

minions.name: Frostbell Polyp
minions.description: Walking jellyfish polyp, opaque ivory bell, black frilled underside, five hooked walking tentacles, frozen bead fringe, dim blue organ

minions.name: Cracktooth Mole
minions.description: Blind charcoal velvet mole, immense shovel palms, porcelain incisors, tiny gray nose, frozen whiskers, short stout tail

minions.name: Shard Quill
minions.description: Porcupine reptile, wrinkled blue-gray hide, uneven needle ice quills on shoulders, narrow beak mouth, four splayed feet, little club tail

minions.name: Brine Lantern
minions.description: Crawling ice sculpin fish, paired muscular fin legs, serrated dorsal sail, milky eyes, thin forehead lure with dim cyan bead

minions.name: Rime Spindle
minions.description: Tall slender mantis insect, vertical thorax, folded black sickle forelegs, four hair-thin walking legs, triangular head, translucent fan abdomen

factions.theme: moonlit pale salt dunes, wind-eroded sandstone fins at edges, broad smooth sand basin, smoky violet shadows

minions.name: Saltglass Gecko
minions.description: Lean gecko, flattened triangular head, huge salt-crusted toe pads, ivory scales, violet-gray belly, thick forked crystalline tail

minions.name: Sievejaw Antlion
minions.description: Squat hairy antlion larva, bulbous wrinkled sand-gray abdomen, six tiny legs, two thin toothed jaws, black eyes, bristle fringe

minions.name: Moonspine Jerboa
minions.description: Emaciated jerboa, enormous hind feet, tiny grasping forepaws, long black-tipped tail, torn funnel ears, salt-stiffened spinal quills

minions.name: Brine Blister
minions.description: Inflated desert toad, charcoal leather skin, translucent brine sacs, ivory nodules, crooked limbs, heavy throat pouch, broad flat face

minions.name: Dune Needlewing
minions.description: Predatory lacewing, four narrow dusty translucent sail wings, needle proboscis, knotted abdomen, feathery antennae, smoky violet veins

minions.name: Chalkcoil Viper
minions.description: Small horned viper, low loose coil, flattened spade snout, chalk granular scales, black hornlets, hooked fangs, broken umber bands

minions.name: Saltroot Strider
minions.description: Rootlike walking stick insect, four bent stilt legs, two twig forearms, hollow seedpod thorax, papery head crest, salt crystals on bark joints

minions.name: Crust Peeler
minions.description: Pangolin-mollusk, chalk limpet shell over shoulders, leathery snout, long black scraping tongue, four low clawed legs, ridged tail

minions.name: Hollow Puff
minions.description: Spherical fungal animal, cracked parchment skin, dark pores, ivory fibrous ruff, six root feet, bent tubular siphon, no emitted cloud

minions.name: Flint Carrionling
minions.description: Hunched flightless vulture runt, bald charcoal neck, chipped flint beak, ragged ivory wing feathers, strong taloned feet

factions.theme: Subterranean fungal ecology, dusty mauve caps, ivory gills, black damp chitin and muted sickly green spores.

minions.name: Gillmask Prowler
minions.description: A lean ferret-like cavern predator with four long paws, bare dark velvet skin, an oval ivory mushroom-gill mask instead of eyes, and a low ridge of mauve shelf fungi along its flexible spine.

minions.name: Pufflung Hopper
minions.description: A round puffball creature on two powerful jointed hopping legs, cracked parchment skin, a small dark toothed breathing opening and several purple-brown spore vents; two tiny balancing claws.

minions.name: Mycelial Mason
minions.description: A squat six-legged fungal worker with a bricklike stack of chalky porous mycelium for a torso, chitin pincers, fine white root whiskers and a single asymmetrical mauve shelf cap as a shoulder shield.

minions.name: Morel Listener
minions.description: A tiny upright salamander-like creature with two huge honeycombed morel ears, blind pinhole face, cream translucent skin, three grasping digits on each hand and a long curled tail.

minions.name: Velvet Sporebat
minions.description: A small cavern bat with ragged mauve suede wings, ivory gill ridges along the wing fingers, dark eyeless face and tiny hooked feet; hanging-free flying pose with full wings visible.

minions.name: Truffle Grinder
minions.description: A broad beetle with a ridged black truffle-like shell split into uneven lobes, cream grinding mandibles, six stout legs and a small crown of branching white fungal threads.

minions.name: Inkcap Drudge
minions.description: A short stooped humanoid made of black ink-like mycelial cords with an elongated dripping inkcap hood, two thick feet, one shovel-shaped hand and one delicate root hand; face entirely hidden by pale gills.

minions.name: Lichen Shepherd
minions.description: A deerlike cave grazer with a low bony body, four narrow hooves, broad fan-shaped lichen growths replacing antlers, a fungal blindfold and a coat of peeling gray barklike scales.

minions.name: Cordyceps Lancer
minions.description: A slender mantis-nymph infected by one long crooked ivory cordyceps spear growing forward from its head, charcoal jointed limbs, a small mauve abdomen and stubby vestigial wings; six limbs.

minions.name: Sponge Whelp
minions.description: A squat amphibian with thick stubby legs, a porous ivory sponge hide, dark open nostril pits, scattered violet fungal bruises and a broad blunt head with tiny moss-green eyes.

factions.theme: storm-beaten black sand shore, distant surf and sea stacks, wet sand and tide pools, rust seaweed

minions.name: Kelp Snatcher
minions.description: Lean octopus, six curling muscular arms, ragged rust-red kelp skin frills, slit eyes, pale sucker rows, mottled slate mantle

minions.name: Barnacle Hopper
minions.description: Amphibious blenny with two long muscular pelvic legs, short fin arms, blunt ugly fish face, ivory spinal barnacles, ragged dorsal fin

minions.name: Brinecomb Urchin
minions.description: Flattened urchin, varied ivory needles, five thick articulated walking spines, small front black mouth, purple-gray test, sparse rusty algae

minions.name: Wrack Hound
minions.description: Small lean seal-dog, wet slate fur, webbed clawed paws, whiskered muzzle, short tail, seaweed around one shoulder, narrow ivory tusks

minions.name: Razorshell Skate
minions.description: Diamond ray, abrasive shell plates only on wing edges, short clawed pelvic feet, whip tail, folded cephalic lobes and small toothed mouth

minions.name: Tide Chisel
minions.description: Thin long-necked shorebird, knobbly webbed legs, hooked chisel beak, charcoal salt-edged feathers, ragged hunched back, folded wings

minions.name: Mussel Maw
minions.description: Upright elongated black mussel, hinged shell slightly open with pale internal tooth ridges and fleshy tongue, three thick tendril feet, barnacle scars

minions.name: Spray Skitter
minions.description: Amphipod sand hopper, curved shrimp body, seven delicate running legs, translucent fan tail, long sensory antennae, no large claws

minions.name: Saltpurse Slug
minions.description: Thick low sea slug, folded charcoal mantle lobes, ivory rear gill branches, two blunt rhinophores, pearly mouth flap, restrained teal spots

minions.name: Breakwater Bristle
minions.description: Short thick bristleworm in shallow S, pale stiff bristles, dark maroon wet segments, four mouth palps, small black hook jaws, no armor

factions.theme: volcanic caldera, stable ash platform, distant lava seams and basalt walls, smoke and falling ash

minions.name: Furnace Tick
minions.description: Flat engorged tick, eight angular charcoal legs, leathery ash-gray abdomen with three faint ember creases, tiny hook mouth, ivory nodules

minions.name: Ashwing Moth
minions.description: Broad moth with ragged soot-black wings and dusty ivory streaks, fuzzy gray body, comb antennae, dim copper abdomen segment

minions.name: Pumice Hare
minions.description: Lean monstrous hare, porous stone-gray hide, long torn ears, angular hind legs, tiny forepaws, ash fur patches, muted orange eye

minions.name: Kilnback Snail
minions.description: Black slug with tall irregular spiral ceramic shell, flaking matte chalk glaze, thick eye stalks, wide rasping mouth, tiny warm seam inside shell

minions.name: Coalspit Toad
minions.description: Squat warty toad, large dark inflated throat sac dimly glowing within, short muscular limbs, ash-encrusted knuckles, tiny black eyes

minions.name: Slag Beak
minions.description: Thin bipedal volcanic crow, long chipped obsidian beak, folded ragged charcoal wings, long ivory talons, ash-white neck hackles

minions.name: Furnace Weasel
minions.description: Long low sinuous weasel, charcoal bristly fur, tiny hooked paws, whip tail, pale toothy muzzle, rust-orange throat patches

minions.name: Glass Lancet
minions.description: Slender smoky obsidian mantis, six articulated limbs, two narrow glass-sickle arms, pale triangular face, fan-folded abdomen, dull copper joints

minions.name: Scoria Tortoise
minions.description: Small tortoise, high porous pumice shell, blunt ash-gray head, thick wrinkled legs, black flint claws, few dull red shell pinholes

minions.name: Vent Siphon
minions.description: Walking anemone, squat charcoal leathery bulb, six thick fleshy support lobes, crown of short curled ivory siphon tubes around tiny warm red mouth

factions.theme: Dead orchard ecology; thornwood, split fruit stones, rust leaves, pale bark, amber sap, no universal spider anatomy.

minions.name: Pip Gnawer
minions.description: A ratlike orchard scavenger with a split peach-stone skull, chisel seed teeth, a coat of rust-colored dead leaves, thin black paws and a long fibrous root tail.

minions.name: Bramble Fawn
minions.description: A small fawn with thornwood ribs, four delicate root hooves, a smooth pale pear-shaped wooden face and antlers formed by two crooked thorn twigs; amber sap beads at joints.

minions.name: Graft Stump
minions.description: A low walking orchard stump on three gnarled root legs, a graft scar forming an angry slit face, one heavy branch club arm and one claw of pruning-thorn growth; dry lichen bark.

minions.name: Orchard Mourner
minions.description: A hunched crow made of curled rust leaves and black bark, with an ivory seed-husk beak, one swollen amber throat gourd and two wiry root legs; folded ragged wings.

minions.name: Burr Roller
minions.description: A spherical burdock husk beast with layered hooked burr plates, four tiny jointed legs, a narrow toothless face opening and amber seed eyes; one side unfolded showing pale fibrous inner rind.

minions.name: Sapwick Gecko
minions.description: A slender bark gecko with six adhesive twig toes per foot, flat leaflike tail, pale peeling trunk-pattern skin and glowing amber sap nodules down its neck; low lateral crawling pose.

minions.name: Pome Husk
minions.description: An animated rotten apple husk split vertically into four thick leathery jaws, pale seed teeth inside, six wiry root feet and a curled dry leaf crest; distinct fruit-shaped compact silhouette.

minions.name: Pruning Wasp
minions.description: A single predatory wasp with a wooden abdomen shaped like pruning shears, narrow ivory thorax, four ragged rust-colored leaf wings, six fine black legs and tiny amber eyes.

minions.name: Rootbound Hare
minions.description: A lean hare with long curled bark ears, hollow amber eye sockets, tangled root hindquarters and two oversized thorn-spiked front paws, gray fur interwoven with dead orchard leaves.

minions.name: Gallows Gourd
minions.description: A hanging-gourd-shaped creature walking on two bent vine stilts, a dry ivory squash skull, a large looped vine arm for snaring and a tassel of small dark seed pods; self-contained no tree.

factions.theme: Smoky quartz cavern scavengers, fractured mineral armor, tiny muted amethyst and amber accents.

minions.name: Shardmuzzle Mole
minions.description: Blind compact mole with powerful slate digging paws, a blunt quartz chisel muzzle, sparse silver whiskers and a few cloudy crystal plates in its charcoal fur; low broad rounded silhouette.

minions.name: Geode Slug
minions.description: Heavy eyeless slug whose split stony back exposes a narrow amethyst geode cavity; fleshy charcoal foot, two tiny pale feelers, folded mineral wrinkles and no legs.

minions.name: Cleftwing Bat
minions.description: Small long-eared cavern bat, angular torn membrane wings with delicate crystalline veins, velvet ash fur, one quartz fang and folded hooked feet; hovering with wings asymmetric.

minions.name: Mica Urchin
minions.description: Low spherical cave urchin on five short fleshy tube feet, layered mica scales among irregular smoky quartz needles, an offset ivory rasp mouth underneath.

minions.name: Flintjaw Newt
minions.description: Lean six-toed cave newt with blunt flint jaws, matte charcoal skin and isolated translucent spine fins, long curling paddle tail, crouching alert.

minions.name: Hollowstone Tick
minions.description: Flattened eight-legged tick with a hollow pebble carapace, delicate hooked legs, tiny sucking proboscis and translucent grey belly with one dim amber inclusion.

minions.name: Quartz Rib Eel
minions.description: Coiling eyeless terrestrial eel with exposed-looking translucent mineral rib hoops, leathery soot skin, two vestigial front flippers and a needle mouth; tall S-shaped pose.

minions.name: Splintercrest Roach
minions.description: Broad armored cave cockroach with asymmetrical chipped slate wing cases, short blunt quartz crest, comb antennae, six low scuttling legs and dusty abdomen.

minions.name: Veinglass Moth
minions.description: Fragile cave moth with four smoky translucent glasslike wings, cloudy mineral vein patterns, fuzzy narrow charcoal body, feathery antennae and one muted violet eye spot.

minions.name: Gravelback Hare
minions.description: Gaunt cave hare with long folded ears tipped in tiny quartz splinters, heavily muscled hind legs, ash fur interrupted by pebble scales and dim amber eyes.

factions.theme: Silk-shrouded ravine brood and scavengers, ivory thread, soot chitin, faded burgundy.

minions.name: Shroud Grub
minions.description: Plump segmented pale grub partly clothed in its own frayed ivory cocoon, small black mandibles, six tiny gripping feet, burgundy veins and soft ring folds.

minions.name: Lacewing Mourner
minions.description: Long delicate lacewing insect with ragged netted ivory wings and a narrow burgundy thorax, threadlike antennae and dangling slender hooked legs.

minions.name: Cocoon Rat
minions.description: Hunched naked ravine rat wearing scraps of abandoned silk around its shoulders, long bare ringed tail, oversized incisors, sharp paws and dull burgundy eyes.

minions.name: Webshoe Toad
minions.description: Squat pale toad with enlarged splayed feet entangled in tough silk mitts, porous grey skin, swollen thread glands behind the eyes and a small burgundy throat.

minions.name: Spindle Centipede
minions.description: Elongated many-legged centipede with alternating soot and ivory chitin segments, two silk bobbin growths at its tail, delicate small mandibles and a low serpentine posture.

minions.name: Veil Mite
minions.description: Tiny round velvet mite enlarged for detail, eight short plush legs, pale masklike face and torn translucent silk veil trailing from its domed burgundy abdomen.

minions.name: Ravine Hookbird
minions.description: Small hunched flightless cliff bird with hooked ivory beak, long grasping toes, ragged charcoal feathers and silk strands tied around its short vestigial wings.

minions.name: Threadbelly Leech
minions.description: Flattened pale leech with puckered circular mouth, translucent belly containing loops of burgundy thread, tiny edge hooks and a curling tapering body.

minions.name: Cowl Cricket
minions.description: Cricket with towering bent jumping legs, ragged ivory silk cowl over a small dark head, ribbed burgundy abdomen and asymmetrical folded wings.

minions.name: Cocoon Hermit
minions.description: Small land hermit creature with two unequal fine pincers and six short black legs, occupying a sideways broken silk cocoon reinforced by splinters and worn red fibers.

factions.theme: collapsed aqueduct reservoir, broken arches, rusted gates, shallow dark water, broad pale silt-covered dry embankment

minions.name: Grate Gnawer
minions.description: Hunched sewer rat, slick charcoal fur, huge pale incisors, long hairless rust-stained tail, splayed toes, blind eyes, shoulder lime scale

minions.name: Silt Lantern
minions.description: Small catfish amphibian, wide flat head, long ivory barbels, four muscular fin legs, narrow tail fin, dim greenish throat bladder, olive-gray skin

minions.name: Pipe Limpet
minions.description: Low mollusk with long half-cylinder shell like mineral-encrusted clay pipe, dark crawling foot, curled sensory stalks, pale rasping mouth

minions.name: Rustwing Caddis
minions.description: Large caddisfly, two tentlike narrow rust-mottled veined wings, six spindly pale legs, long antennae, blind head, silt-encrusted abdomen

minions.name: Weir Stilt
minions.description: Gaunt heronlike sewer bird, bent long neck, needle beak, two tall scaly legs, vestigial gray wings, milky eyes, wet moss-green breast fringe

minions.name: Sluice Sowbug
minions.description: Broad flat woodlouse, seven limestone-white back segments, many short rust-dark legs, forked antennae, black head, algae in plate cracks

minions.name: Drainbell Jelly
minions.description: Translucent gray bell polyp, rusty iron veins, four short thick crawling tentacles, thread sensory tassels, internal silt granules, dim pale green core

minions.name: Limejaw Frog
minions.description: Lean blind long-limbed frog, squared calcified ivory lower jaw, olive-black wrinkled skin, oversized webbed rear feet, cloudy eyes, rust blotches

minions.name: Chain Tuft
minions.description: Knotted aquatic worm colony forming one creature, dark ribbon body loops around one corroded broken iron link, pale bristled feeding crown, three trailing feelers

minions.name: Reservoir Shear
minions.description: Freshwater prawn, narrow translucent limestone-gray abdomen, mismatched long scissor claws, six fine walking legs, thread antennae, folded fan tail

factions.theme: Wasteland procession followers, old iron, bone charms, tarnished brass, faded wine cloth.

minions.name: Clapper Hound
minions.description: Lean mangy hound with a heavy old iron clapper fused beneath its jaw, small bone collar charms, long ivory forelegs and scraps of dark red cloth at the neck.

minions.name: Tollwing Crow
minions.description: Hunched crow with sparse soot feathers, a small tarnished bronze throat resonator, bone beak tip and a single broken chain loop around one claw.

minions.name: Chainback Roly-poly
minions.description: Broad low woodlouse with overlapping rust iron links forming its armor, many tiny ivory feet, short feelers and a frayed burgundy cloth scrap caught at its rear.

minions.name: Cinder Censer Imp
minions.description: Small hunched two-legged soot creature with a perforated iron chest cage holding dim embers, long wiry arms, blank bone face and a short chain tail; no loose smoke.

minions.name: Knucklebone Hopper
minions.description: Odd flightless locust built from weathered ivory chitin resembling knucklebones, massive folded hind legs, dull brass abdomen rings and short broken antennae.

minions.name: Rusthorn Snail
minions.description: Snail with a worn spiral iron shell, two antlerlike rusted horn feelers, wrinkled grey foot and a pair of tiny dangling bone beads attached to the shell rim.

minions.name: Mourning Kite
minions.description: Small ray-shaped flying beast made of leathery soot skin and ragged wine-colored membranes, a pointed bone face and trailing segmented chainlike tail; no bells.

minions.name: Chime-throat Gecko
minions.description: Splayed-foot gecko with pale leathery skin, swollen translucent throat containing tiny dull brass nodules, a curled tail and rust-colored scale patches.

minions.name: Ash Pannier Beetle
minions.description: Compact six-legged dung beetle with two uneven woven bone baskets grown along its back, matte iron shell, shovel head and a few frayed faded cloth ties.

minions.name: Rattlejaw Vagrant
minions.description: Short stooped bipedal scavenger with oversized bone jaw, narrow wrapped charcoal torso, long clawed arms and rusted ankle rings, carrying a simple crooked staff.

factions.theme: Soot-stained nocturnal wasteland ecology: scorched vellum, charcoal fur, dusty burgundy, pale silk.

minions.name: Soot Snout
minions.description: A hunched mole with split ivory digging claws, soot-matted black fur, a blind stitched-looking muzzle and pale silk sacs strapped naturally among dorsal quills. Broad forequarters, short rear legs, no wings.

minions.name: Vellum Hound
minions.description: A gaunt six-legged jackal, long ivory muzzle and charcoal pelt, with torn parchment-like membranes only between its rear limbs, ragged burgundy ear edges and cocoon silk caught around its narrow waist.

minions.name: Cocoon Porter
minions.description: A squat hermit beetle with four heavy walking legs and two fine mouth palps, carrying one huge broken ivory cocoon as a spiral shell, its exposed charcoal chitin and rust-red seam contrasting the soft silk lining.

minions.name: Ashcomb Toad
minions.description: A broad low toad with a ridged honeycomb of dry seedlike ash blisters on its back, pale craggy throat pouch, charcoal warted skin and long delicate insectlike finger tips; one small burgundy eye.

minions.name: Shroud Mantis
minions.description: A thin tall mantis with praying serrated forearms, knobby black limbs and a torn ivory cocoon veil draped over its triangular head, abdomen rolled under, no grand wings.

minions.name: Wicktail Rat
minions.description: A wiry long-legged rat with dense black fur, a split lash tail ending in pale silk tassels, bony cheek plates and paired small burgundy throat sacs, crouched in an alert pounce.

minions.name: Embergill Slug
minions.description: A heavy elongated ash-gray slug rearing its small pointed head, with folded ivory gill fans down its back, clotted burgundy slime contained on its skin and tiny black rasp teeth, no emitted trail.

minions.name: Pallid Lanternfly
minions.description: A strange long-snouted lanternfly with only two narrow horizontal translucent ivory wings, a swollen soot-gray abdomen, six hooked feet tucked in flight and a burgundy ceramic-looking forehead bulb.

minions.name: Funeral Puff
minions.description: A mobile puffball fungus with a cracked parchment bulb, narrow black root legs and an open burgundy throatlike spore aperture; several tattered silk filaments tied around its neck, no airborne cloud.

minions.name: Cinder Tick
minions.description: An oval armored tick with eight compact grappling legs, a flattened ash-black shell divided by fine pale vellum seams and an underslung ivory rasping jaw; restrained burgundy joints, broad low silhouette.

factions.theme: Ruined reliquary scavengers and lesser guardians, weathered pale stone, bronze fittings, muted amber.

minions.name: Votive Scorpion
minions.description: Small stone-plated scorpion with slender bronze pincers, many fine legs and a curled segmented tail ending in a hollow unlit candle-socket stinger.

minions.name: Urnback Snail
minions.description: Grey snail sheltering inside a chipped squat funerary urn, faint worn carvings and bronze repair staples, two long soft eye stalks and a wrinkled broad foot.

minions.name: Crypt Key Weasel
minions.description: Long lean ash-furred weasel with a crooked bronze keylike tail tip, stone-crusted shoulders, sharp pale paws and a tiny dull amber eye.

minions.name: Mortar Mite
minions.description: Flattened mite with six chunky stone-white legs, soft charcoal joints, porous mortar carapace with a single moss-dark seam and tiny bronze-colored mandibles.

minions.name: Lantern Gnat
minions.description: Delicate long-legged gnat with a translucent amber abdominal sac held inside fine bronze rib struts, two smoky veined wings and a sharp small ivory head.

minions.name: Ossuary Toad
minions.description: Wide squat toad with cracked limestone skin, bone-white wart knobs, a dark cavernous mouth and short strong forelegs bound by corroded bronze natural bands.

minions.name: Tileback Pangolin
minions.description: Small pangolin with overlapping chipped pale funerary tiles instead of scales, bronze repair pins, narrow black snout, heavy digging claws and curled tapering tail.

minions.name: Cenotaph Limpet
minions.description: Low limpet beast with a peaked weathered stone shell like a broken grave marker, irregular bronze edge brackets, radial grey gripping tentacles and a hidden amber eye.

minions.name: Relic Pecker
minions.description: Ragged long-necked bird with a chisel stone beak, dusty charcoal feathers, narrow bronze brow ridge and powerful gripping ivory claws, perched pose without perch.

minions.name: Bronze Writhe
minions.description: Legless twisting worm armored in loose irregular bronze rings, a pale soft head with four small stone teeth, soot-colored folds and a blunt curled tail.

factions.theme: Cursed sewing familiars and thornwoven constructs, weathered linen, bone needles, restrained red thread.

minions.name: Pincushion Hog
minions.description: Low squat hedgehog with faded linen patches sewn across its back, uneven thorn and bone-needle spines, small charcoal snout, short paws and sparse dark red stitches.

minions.name: Hem Rat
minions.description: Long-tailed scruffy rat made partly of patched ash linen, real dark paws and whiskers, frayed red thread tail strands and a tiny button-like black eye.

minions.name: Shearjaw Mantis
minions.description: Small lean mantis with crooked thorn legs and paired tarnished shear blades as jaws, folded grey leaf wings, narrow ivory torso and one red thread binding at the neck.

minions.name: Bobbin Snail
minions.description: Wrinkled charcoal snail carrying an old wooden spool shell wound with faded red thread, frayed linen apron-like skin folds and two slender bone feelers.

minions.name: Thimble Beetle
minions.description: Round six-legged beetle whose punctured tarnished thimble carapace sits over a soft stitched linen abdomen, thorn feet and small dark red mandibles.

minions.name: Ragwing Bat
minions.description: Small skeletal bat with tattered grey patchwork linen wings held by bone spars and visibly uneven red stitches, dark furry chest, folded ears and tiny clawed feet.

minions.name: Briar Dolly
minions.description: Child-sized crude nonhuman twig doll with a bulbous stuffed linen head, two mismatched button eyes, crooked single-jointed branch limbs and sparse red seam stitches; eerie not cute.

minions.name: Seam Ripper Worm
minions.description: Long pale cloth-skinned worm with a forked bone seam-ripper mouth, tight segmented red thread sutures, thorn barbs along its underside and curled muscular tail.

minions.name: Pattern Hare
minions.description: Gaunt long-eared hare assembled from irregular grey linen pattern scraps, thin exposed twig hindlegs, thorn whiskers and one small dark red stitch line on its flank.

minions.name: Knot Spider
minions.description: Low broad eight-legged spider whose abdomen is a tangled knot of faded red thread around a dark seed pod, needle-thin ivory legs, tiny thorn jaws and ragged linen tufts.

factions.theme: Abandoned kiln servants and volcanic fauna: charcoal basalt, rust iron, chalk fragments, restrained ember seams.

minions.name: Slag Jackal
minions.description: A lean quadruped jackal built from layered clinker scales, a narrow iron muzzle, hooked scrap-metal claws and a long articulated tail; tiny ember seams at throat and knees.

minions.name: Kiln Crab
minions.description: A squat six-legged crab with a rounded cracked kiln-pot shell, one flat shovel-like rust-iron pincer and one delicate coal-tong claw, a small furnace slit beneath its shell.

minions.name: Bellows Bat
minions.description: A leathery bat-shaped animated bellows with pleated soot-black ribbed wings, rusty hinge bones, short hooked feet and a narrow nozzle snout, a dim coal glow visible inside the mouth.

minions.name: Clinker Urchin
minions.description: A low round mineral beast on five stubby stone feet, armored in uneven charcoal clinker spikes and chalky shards, small ember-red eyes set beneath a rusted iron rim.

minions.name: Forge Newt
minions.description: A long squat salamander with black pumice skin, white mineral barnacles across its shoulders, paddle toes and a heavy curling tail, three restrained orange slits along its flank.

minions.name: Chain Gnawer
minions.description: A stocky hyena-sized rodent with broken anvil-like incisors, soot-matted fur threaded with short rusty chain loops and stout iron-capped paws, a lumpy charcoal growth across its spine.

minions.name: Shard Stilt
minions.description: A narrow tripod automaton on three spindly rust-iron legs, a tilted cracked crucible torso filled with ivory furnace shards and one small ember eye behind a slotted mask, no humanoid arms.

minions.name: Coal Borer
minions.description: A segmented black basalt larva with a blunt circular iron drill mouth, six small hooked ivory digging claws near its head and ember pinholes between rear plates, coiled low and menacing.

minions.name: Cinder Sack
minions.description: A hunched sack-bodied imp stitched from scorched hide around a compact coal belly, knobby twiglike iron legs and long mitten hands, a rusty chimney collar and dim amber cracks, no flame plume.

minions.name: Tongs Widow
minions.description: An agile four-legged foundry spider with a tiny rusted brazier abdomen, two long opposing coal-tong forelimbs, chalk encrusted joints and a recessed orange eye, silhouette delicate rather than massive.

factions.theme: Funerary waxcraft and abandoned chapel vermin: warm ivory wax, black cloth, tarnished brass, tiny amber wicks.

minions.name: Tallow Hound
minions.description: A thin black burial-cloth hound whose back is armored with lumpy melted ivory wax, bare brass jaw hinges, narrow claw feet and a single unlit wick at its forehead, ears like torn shrouds.

minions.name: Candle Crab
minions.description: A squat crab made of hardened ivory candle drips around a tarnished brass votive cup, six black jointed legs, asymmetric wax pincers and a tiny burning wick recessed in its cup.

minions.name: Wick Stitcher
minions.description: A spindly humanoid wax puppet with an oversized featureless oval head sewn shut by black wick, two short brass needle arms, bent skinny legs and a small ragged funeral apron, no hood.

minions.name: Pew Maggot
minions.description: A fat pale wax-coated larva with black cloth rings between its segments, a round brass jaw and four tiny hooked front limbs, a stubby soot-dark tail and a small amber eye.

minions.name: Votive Snail
minions.description: A broad charcoal snail carrying a cracked ivory wax spiral shell pierced by three short spent candle sockets, antennae tipped with tarnished brass beads, hanging wax scallops confined to its body.

minions.name: Mourning Bat
minions.description: A small black-furred bat with ragged funeral-lace wing membranes, dripping ivory wax plates over its shoulders and a brass bell clapper for a lower jaw, wings swept upward and claws curled.

minions.name: Sealmouth Acolyte
minions.description: A short stooped undead attendant with face entirely sealed by a thick round ivory wax disk, knotted black robes above visible thin shins, carrying a narrow brass candle snuffer across its body.

minions.name: Dripjaw Toad
minions.description: A heavy squat toad sculpted from gray tallow with ivory stalactite wax teeth around an open black mouth, coarse funeral-thread sutures and stout bent legs, one tiny amber wick eye.

minions.name: Censer Tick
minions.description: A large flattened six-legged tick whose body is an oval tarnished brass incense cage filled with solidified ivory wax, black hook feet and small opposing needle jaws, no smoke.

minions.name: Pallbearer Hand
minions.description: A severed animated giant wax hand walking on four long blackened fingers, thumb raised as a hook, a brass funeral ring and fraying black ribbon tied around its capped wrist, clearly hand-shaped.

factions.theme: Rugged wasteland pack ecology; chipped flint, dark bristles, ivory scrimshaw bone, weathered hide and restrained burgundy ties.

minions.name: Shale Jackal
minions.description: A lean jackal with angular shale plates down its back, oversize chipped ivory canine teeth, dark wiry fur, narrow brindled legs and a torn burgundy cord around one foreleg.

minions.name: Knap Claw
minions.description: A squat badgerlike creature with huge flint foreclaws, a blunt bone snout mask, dark bristled shoulders and small unarmored rear legs; asymmetrical chipped stone elbow plates.

minions.name: Scree Hopper
minions.description: A two-legged rock locust with oversized springing flint hind legs, a compact black chitin body, blunt bone head crest, folded cracked gray wings and short ivory feelers.

minions.name: Tuskroot Marmot
minions.description: A stout marmot with two downward ivory shovel incisors, dark bristles braided with burgundy fiber, wide bare digging palms and a low ridge of chipped stone scales.

minions.name: Cairn Beetle
minions.description: A six-legged beetle with three stacked flat flint slabs for its shell, thick bone pincers, a narrow crimson underside and chalk-white scratch marks in the stone; no massive boss armor.

minions.name: Splinter Owl
minions.description: A small ground owl with a jagged flint facial disc, deep amber eyes, black bristly feathers, ivory talons and uneven slate shoulder quills; wings partly lifted.

minions.name: Knuckle Ram
minions.description: A compact rocky ram with one broken flint horn and one curled ivory horn, a slablike forehead, patchy charcoal wool, thick jointed legs and a short ragged burgundy tether.

minions.name: Quarry Skink
minions.description: A flat wasteland skink with overlapping chipped flint scales, broad spade tail, six short legs, pale ridged jaw and tiny orange eyes; camouflaged charcoal-gray matte texture.

minions.name: Bonepick Scrounger
minions.description: A small hunched imp with dark hide, long pointed ears, an ivory jaw-guard, a bundle of chipped flint tools strapped to its back and one crooked bone pick held in a thin clawed hand.

minions.name: Bristleback Shrew
minions.description: An aggressive elongated shrew with fine needle teeth, a fan of black quills tipped with tiny flint chips, sinewy paws, a narrow ivory snout shield and a whipping naked tail.

factions.theme: Drowned divination cult and abyssal familiars: charcoal wet cloth, cracked ivory ceramic, aged brass, muted sea-green organs.

minions.name: Brine Mask
minions.description: A hovering broken ivory porcelain face mask with asymmetrical eye holes, a charcoal jellyfish body behind it and eight thin ribbon tentacles with tiny brass beads, a dim sea-green throat.

minions.name: Silt Hound
minions.description: An emaciated amphibious hound with slate-gray skin, webbed claw feet, a cracked ivory muzzle plate and small brass divination charms tangled in short kelp-like neck fringes.

minions.name: Augur Crab
minions.description: A squat four-legged crab carrying a shallow cracked ceramic divining dish as its shell, two small hooked claws, worn brass seams and a muted green living pearl inside its body.

minions.name: Bell Diver
minions.description: A short hunched drowned diver creature with an oversized tarnished brass bell helmet, dark eel-like arms, ceramic knee plates and broad flipper feet, one dim green window and no human face.

minions.name: Ribbon Eel
minions.description: A long floating eel with a pale cracked ceramic skull, charcoal translucent body tapering into three wet cloth ribbons, a row of tiny brass vertebral rings and muted green gills, curled in an S shape.

minions.name: Blind Pool Newt
minions.description: A low broad blind salamander with smooth stone-gray skin, pale lidless eye scars, delicate black external gills and porcelain-like armor spots, long flat tail and restrained sea-green throat.

minions.name: Lot Caster
minions.description: A small bent cult imp with a dark conical reed mask, long pale fingers holding three blank chipped ceramic counters, wet ragged shawl, narrow bare feet and a brass weight on its belt.

minions.name: Pearl Leech
minions.description: A thick upright leech curled into a hooked posture, charcoal ringed skin, an open ivory circular mouth surrounding a muted green pearl and a few tarnished brass loops embedded down its back.

minions.name: Undertow Urchin
minions.description: A squat sea-urchin creature walking on five long jointed pale tube feet, black stubby spines around a cracked ivory ceramic core and a tiny green eye, no watery scenery.

minions.name: Tideglass Ray
minions.description: A narrow diamond-bodied ray floating with folded smoky gray translucent fins, a cracked ivory crest, pale underside with one soft sea-green organ and a thin tail ending in a brass plummet.

factions.theme: Ossuary scavengers that answer a death-song: weathered bone, ragged charcoal feathers, gut strings, tarnished brass bells.

minions.name: Rattlejack
minions.description: A lean skeletal jackal with short ragged black feather tufts along its spine, bone jaw slightly open, a few brass rattles suspended beneath its ribs and taut sinew binding its narrow legs.

minions.name: Rib Cricket
minions.description: A large hunched cricket with curved ivory rib armor over a charcoal body, immense bent jumping legs, short ragged wings and a pair of taut gut strings across its forelimbs.

minions.name: Bell Vulture
minions.description: A hunched vulture with a small weathered bone skull, ragged black wing feathers, a bare sinewy neck and a single tarnished brass bell tied below its breast; wings half opened, full legs visible.

minions.name: Marrow Rat
minions.description: A large bony rat with patchy charcoal fur, exposed ivory spinal knobs, a long naked segmented tail threaded through two small brass rings and thin clawed feet, nose tilted toward the left.

minions.name: Dirge Toad
minions.description: A broad squat black toad with an inflated pale throat sac braced by curved rib-like struts, tiny brass studs along its jaw, coarse featherlike back warts and long spread finger bones.

minions.name: Ossuary Snail
minions.description: A charcoal snail bearing a shell assembled from overlapping weathered vertebrae in a spiral, two thin bone antennae and a dangling brass chime tucked close beneath the shell.

minions.name: Sinew Walker
minions.description: A strange animated bone tripod with a small raven skull suspended between three long jointed legs by taut gut strings, sparse black feathers around its central knot and tiny brass tuning pegs.

minions.name: Grave Marten
minions.description: A sinuous long-bodied marten with four low limbs, charcoal pelt, ivory skull-mask face and a fan of tattered black tail feathers threaded with one dull brass ring, spine arched in motion.

minions.name: Knell Beetle
minions.description: A stocky six-legged beetle with an ivory skull-like carapace over black chitin, broad shovel mandibles and a round tarnished bell chamber integrated into its abdomen, no bird wings.

minions.name: Mute Cantor
minions.description: A short crouched bone-faced scavenger imp with a stitched shut beaklike mouth, ragged black feather cloak, long pale arms cradling a tiny rib-and-sinew lyre, thin bent legs and brass ankle rings.

factions.theme: Alchemical wasteland vermin; smoky green glass, tarnished brass ribs, bone masks, contained dim green reagents; no centipede copies.

minions.name: Retort Tick
minions.description: A broad eight-legged tick whose swollen abdomen is one cracked smoky-green glass retort held in brass ribs, a small bone needle-mouth and hooked jointed black legs; contained reagent inside.

minions.name: Ampoule Skate
minions.description: A small floating ray-shaped creature with a thin smoky glass body, two wide translucent membrane fins reinforced with brass veins, an ivory faceplate and a segmented whip tail; no scenery.

minions.name: Verdigris Mole
minions.description: A compact eyeless mole with tarnished brass digging claws, gray leathery skin, two rounded green-glass cheek reservoirs and a flexible plated tail, pale bone whisker sockets.

minions.name: Phial Mantis
minions.description: A fragile praying mantis with two long glass scalpel forearms, a brass cage thorax enclosing a single green phial, black wiry walking limbs and a tiny pale skull-shaped insect head.

minions.name: Crucible Hatchling
minions.description: A squat amphibian with a cracked black ceramic bowl-shaped back containing a dim green organ, brass-lipped jaws, stubby webbed feet and tiny uneven smoky glass horns.

minions.name: Lens Louse
minions.description: A flattened armored louse with one large cloudy green convex lens as its head, six short brass-hook legs, a smoky glass shield over pale organs and delicate ivory feelers.

minions.name: Siphon Wren
minions.description: A skeletal wren with a long curved glass siphon beak, a ribbed brass breast cage, ragged charcoal feathers, pale bone legs and a small green reagent sac beneath its throat.

minions.name: Alembic Slug
minions.description: An elongated black slug with three unequal green glass alembic bulbs growing from its back, tiny brass clamps, a broad ivory scraping mouth and a few short fleshy feelers; clean isolated silhouette.

minions.name: Shardhand Homunculus
minions.description: A small stooped humanoid made from stitched gray hide and brass wire, asymmetrical smoky-glass shard hands, a blank ivory doll face and one green glass chest window revealing a coiled organ.

minions.name: Bottlejaw Weasel
minions.description: A slender weasel with articulated brass spinal braces, dark velvet fur, a transparent green-glass lower jaw with tiny ivory teeth, four swift clawed feet and a thin curled tail.
